capabilities: fold properties automatically on note open
leave new notes unfolded for metadata entry
remember unfold state once per session
extras: README stresses the plugin is non-destructive and only changes UI display, never file contents.
problem: Obsidian opens notes with the properties section expanded, which takes up editor space when you are not editing metadata.
summary: Plugin that automatically folds the frontmatter properties panel when a note opens, with folder targeting and per-session memory.
